verdict.rationale: Riveter documents outbound HTTP webhooks. You pass `webhook_url` when starting a run, and Riveter POSTs the full results to that URL with named events (run.completed, run.stopped, run.finished). The OpenAPI guidance recommends webhooks over polling, so a programmatic consumer can receive run-completion events. Missing for 10: account-level or standing webhook subscriptions beyond per-run registration, documented signature verification and delivery retries, a broader event catalog (e.g. scheduled monitor changes), and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks

citations.quote: Pass webhook_url in the JSON body when starting a run and Riveter POSTs the full results to your URL when it finishes (events: run.completed, run.stopped, run.finished).
Prefer webhooks over polling: pass `webhook_url` on kickoff and Riveter POSTs the results to you when the run finishes.
